name: codex-claude-gateway
goal: Prove Claude Max streaming, Codex-owned tools, follow-up history and native OpenAI switching before installing dependent monitoring plugins

steps.title: Confirm scope, success criteria, constraints, and proof.
steps.evidence: Accepted scope, first desktop gate and partial prototype constraints recorded in specification/features/planned/codex-claude-gateway.md. Desktop computer-use access refused; implementation and verification remain pending.

steps.title: Implement the smallest complete feature slice.
Add or update focused automated coverage.
Run the relevant project verification commands.
Prove installed desktop Claude streaming, Codex tool execution, follow-up history and return to native OpenAI before dependent integration.
Capture red and green protocol safety regressions for the first-stage prototype.
steps.evidence: Red: vitest focused serializer/session/validator/HTTP suite failed 6 assertions on generated stubs at 12:39. Green: same assertions passed unchanged at 12:43. Retry suite failed 2 assertions at 12:46, then both passed unchanged at 12:47. Additional tests cover orphaned continuation rejection, replayed call/output history, cancellation, SDK failure, credential overrides and stream errors. Desktop compatibility remains failed/blocked.

steps.title: Prove subscription-backed SDK streaming and correlated bridge continuation in isolation.
steps.evidence: Live ignored smoke script ran Claude Opus 5.5/xhigh through the gateway, received read_marker call ID, supplied gateway-marker-72 as matching function_call_output, then observed incremental output_text.delta and response.completed containing that marker. Repeated after safety changes. Host-supplied result is not desktop Codex execution. Native bundled CLI attempt failed stream completion; desktop gate stays pending.
